item.title: Fixing Keycloak's "HTTPS required" behind cloudflared and Envoy Gateway
item.description:
In my Kubernetes cluster, public services are exposed through a Cloudflare Tunnel: cloudflared runs in the cluster and forwards requests to Envoy Gateway, which routes them to the applications. When I published Keycloak this way, every page answered with a 403 and the message “HTTPS required”, although the browser was on https://. This article explains why and shows a small fix at the route level.

item.title: HashiCorp Vault OIDC with Keycloak
item.description:
HashiCorp Vault supports authenticating users via OIDC, which means it can delegate login to an existing Keycloak instance instead of managing its own set of credentials.

Keycloak client settings

In Keycloak, create a client for Vault with Client authentication set to ON, so that Keycloak issues a client secret for it.

Policy
